item: The benchmark member runs its slow trending cases last and reports the cases a deadline kept it from as not run
summary: A 304.7 s benchmark ran into the member's 300 s deadline after two 60 s trending cases and reported four cheap cases as 'interrupted' when they never ran. The trending cases now run last; a case the deadline passed before is 'not run: the member's deadline had passed' with deadline_left_ms; a statement the deadline stopped says so; the summary carries cases_not_run and a deadline block (left at start, reached after, which cases).
